newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey plans Dec 16 Iraq oil loading ceremony.
newsitem.headline: Turkey plans Dec 16 Iraq oil loading ceremony.

text.p: An energy ministry official said on Tuesday that Turkey was likely to hold a ceremony on December 16 to celebrate the loading of oil tankers with Iraqi oil being exported under the U.N. oil-for-food deal.
"The ceremony is most likely to be held on Monday, December 16," ministry spokesman Ilhan Ozege told Reuters.
He said Deputy Prime Minister Tansu Ciller would take part in the ceremony at the Mediterranean port of Ceyhan, to where Iraqi oil began flowing under the U.N. deal.
Iraqi Oil Minister Amir Muhammad Rasheed said earlier in a statement that Iraq would pump 650,000 barrels on Tuesday from Kirkuk through its pipeline to Turkey.
Rasheed said Iraq would give preference to Turkey in selling its oil.

The United Nations gave Iraq clearance on Monday to start resuming limited exports from Tuesday under an "oil-for-food" deal to buy humanitarian aid for Iraqis suffering under economic sanctions imposed after Iraq invaded Kuwait in 1990.
